message.content:
CLOUD DESIGN RE-REVIEW seat (round 4) for the combined CI design (group R10-CI-LAYOUT) of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer. You are independent: neither a designer nor the revision author. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor.
Inputs: revision 3 `probe/design-ci-rev3` (8bd4e68f, RESPONSE.md has `## Round-3 item` sections), round-3 review `probe/design-ci-review3` (f731b201: R3-1 blocking; R3-2 to R3-5 and editorial points), revision 2 `probe/design-ci-rev2` (d775cc6c), round-2 review `probe/design-ci-review2` (d63cbe42); round-1 review `probe/design-ci-review` (f7b28312: REVIEW.md + ev/, verdict revise, 12 items); revision `probe/design-ci-rev1` (485ae940: DESIGN-P1.md, DESIGN-P2.md, measure/, RESPONSE.md); originals `probe/design-ci-layout` (b7a76185) and `probe/design-ci-umbrella` (7fdd39c4). Read CLAUDE.md, dev/governance/roles/judge.md, fix-review.md, ci-autofix.md, gate-scoping.md and orchestrator.md from origin/main.
Task: first decide whether R3-1 and each of R3-2 to R3-4 and the editorial points are resolved, using the round-3 reviewer's tools (timing_perturb) as well as your own, and confirm that R3-5's R-10 is ruled. Then confirm every item from rounds 1 and 2 still holds. for each of the 12 round-1 items, decide resolved / not resolved, with evidence you ran yourself (re-run every changed instrument; model the concurrency, retarget and gate cases adversarially against GitHub's documented semantics). Then look for NEW defects the revision introduced. Check that the owner rulings are carried: D-1 approve, D-2 arch-score gate-required when the diff reaches custom_components/, D-3 keep merge_group, D-4 drop C1 in PR 1 only if the proof is shown covered, D-5 keep O17 with a soundness check; variant: a review event re-runs only budget-raise-gate and gate. Owner ruling R-10, under mandate: option B. pr-contract lists the open alerts of the matched analyses; 4.3 step 5 is dropped; U6 must show a planted python-only finding listed. Check that the design carries it. Plan: two PRs, phase 1 first; cloud fan-out per unit.
Output: REVIEW.md, whose first line is exactly `Design review: approve` or `Design review: revise`, plus ev/. Approve only when every item is resolved and nothing new blocks. Return: commit REVIEW.md and ev/ and push ONLY `refs/heads/probe/design-ci-review4`. No PRs, comments or workflow edits on real branches. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or refusal; report it.
